summary: First iteration end-to-end tests of the Tidy to-do app. Backend: 26/26 pytest cases passed covering lists CRUD (incl. Inbox protection + task reassignment), task CRUD + validations (empty/whitespace/length/invalid list_id), filters (list_id, status, search case-insensitive on title+notes, view=today/overdue), sort (due nulls last, priority high-first, newest), counts endpoint shape, scoped clear-completed, and restore (same id). Frontend: UI loads with seeded data (Inbox/Work/Personal, 6 tasks, 1 overdue red chip, 1 today, 1 completed, 1 no due date). Verified quick-add via Enter, empty-title toast error (no creation), toggle complete, side-panel edit + save persistence, delete with Undo toast that restores by id, create/delete list via menu confirm, search (reduced to 1 result for 'proposal'), status tabs, sort dropdown with all three options, progress text '1 of 6 done', mobile 390px menu + drawer. No critical issues found.

design_issues.screen: Dialogs (create list, delete confirm, mobile drawer)
issues: Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby/Description - a11y console warnings. Add <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby to DialogContent for screen reader support.

action_items: (Low) Add Dialog descriptions / aria-describedby to Radix DialogContent to silence a11y warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L178-179: status=done + view=overdue uses {'_id': {'$exists': False}} as a 'return nothing' trick. Works, but a dedicated short-circuit (return []) would be clearer and avoid an unnecessary DB round-trip.
server.py restore endpoint overwrites via replace_one upsert=True - if a task with same id already exists it is silently replaced. Consider rejecting if exists to avoid accidental overwrite.
No pagination on GET /api/tasks (hard-coded to_list(5000)); fine for single-user MVP but note the ceiling.
CORS allow_origins read from env is good; allow_credentials=True combined with wildcard would be a risk - verify prod CORS_ORIGINS is not '*'.
seed_data_creation: No manual seed required - app auto-seeds Inbox/Work/Personal + 6 tasks on first startup. Tests created temporary TEST_* data and cleaned it up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_todo_api.py run in parallel (xdist) in ~4s. UI testids match spec exactly. Mobile drawer uses dialog pattern - minor a11y warnings only. Keep DB intact; tests clean up after themselves.
